resources.string: Sends about half as much data between phones on every step of a split run.
Halves the data sent between phones on every step of a split run, which helps on slow Wi-Fi.
It uses BF16, which keeps the full number range (no overflow) but only about 3 significant digits. Results can differ slightly from an unsplit run with the same seed.
Only matters when the model is split across devices. It has no effect on chat.
This phone needs version 1.00009 or newer. Older Helpers work fine.
